skill.name: transitions-polish
skill.description: Reviews existing interface motion and refines durations, easing, distance, scale, blur, stagger, and delays against the transitions.dev token system.
skill.summary: Audit and refine existing interface motion with usage-based transitions.dev tokens.
skill.author: jakubantalik

security_audit.summary: All static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code spans, documentation links, and CSS terminology. The skill requests project scanning and confirmed source edits for its stated motion-polishing purpose, with no malicious intent or prompt injection found.

content.value_statement: Inconsistent timing and easing can make interface motion feel slow or distracting. This skill audits existing motion and maps each usage to suitable transitions.dev tokens.
actual_capabilities: Scans CSS and component styles for durations, easing curves, translation distances, scales, and blur values.
Maps motion values to tokens according to interface usage instead of numeric proximity.
Reviews open and close asymmetry, hover behavior, stagger totals, and intent delays.
Reports proposed changes by file before editing source files.
Applies confirmed motion refinements while preserving unrelated formatting and code.
Provides a reusable CSS token file for centralized motion values.
limitations: It refines existing motion and does not design complete transition recipes.
Usage inference depends on clear selectors, component names, and surrounding code.
Token suggestions may not fit custom brand motion or unusual interaction requirements.
Source changes require user confirmation and should be reviewed in the resulting diff.

use_cases.title: Standardize Product Motion
use_cases.description: Audit a product interface and replace inconsistent motion values with shared tokens.

use_cases.title: Review Interaction Quality
use_cases.description: Check modal, tooltip, panel, and hover motion against consistent interaction rules.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Design System
use_cases.description: Identify reusable motion values and introduce a centralized token scale.

prompt_templates.title: Review All Motion
prompt_templates.prompt: Run transitions review across this project. List inconsistent motion values by file and explain each suggested token.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Review motion in [component path]. Check duration, easing, distance, scale, blur, stagger, and delay without editing.

prompt_templates.title: Polish Confirmed Findings
prompt_templates.prompt: Run transitions polish for [scope]. Show the proposal first, then apply only the changes I confirm.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Interaction Semantics
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [scope] for open-close asymmetry, hover return behavior, stagger totals, and intent delays. Preserve unmatched custom motion and explain every exception.

output_examples.input: Review the modal and dropdown transitions without editing.
output: Modal close: reduce 300 milliseconds to the quick 150-millisecond token.
Dropdown open: keep the existing fast 250-millisecond token.

output_examples.input: Polish the list stagger after I approve the proposal.
output: Proposed eight stagger changes in the list styles.
Updated one file with no unrelated formatting changes.

output_examples.input: Check whether the tooltip delay and easing are suitable.
output_examples.output: The 80-millisecond intent delay is suitable. Use the standard ease-out token for tooltip opening and closing.

best_practices: Run a review before applying changes to understand the proposed scope.
Evaluate tokens by interaction purpose, not by the nearest numeric value.
Review the final diff and test motion with real content and input methods.
anti_patterns: Do not replace unmatched custom motion only because its value is near a token.
Do not delay closing or hover-out interactions.
Do not mix motion polishing with unrelated source formatting or refactoring.

faq.question: Does this skill add new animations?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on refining motion that already exists in the project.

faq.question: Can it review a single file?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide a file, component, line, or value to limit the review scope.

faq.question: Does review mode edit source files?
faq.answer: No. Review mode reports suggested changes and waits for a separate polish request.

faq.question: Will polish mode ask before editing?
faq.answer: Yes. It presents a short proposal and requests confirmation before applying changes.

faq.question: Which styling systems are supported?
faq.answer: It covers CSS, CSS Modules, CSS-in-JS, Tailwind configuration, inline styles, and Motion or Framer variants.

faq.question: Is the transitions.dev token file required?
faq.answer: No. The skill can use literal values, but the token file centralizes future adjustments.
